Arjany Martha.note: Martha is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Arjany Martha.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Armando Obispo.note: Obispo stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Armando Obispo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Brandley Kuwas.note: Kuwas stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Brandley Kuwas.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Deveron Fonville.note: Fonville's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Deveron Fonville.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Eloy Room.note: Watch Room for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Eloy Room.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Gervane Kastaneer.note: Kastaneer's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Gervane Kastaneer.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Godfried Roemeratoe.note: Roemeratoe's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Godfried Roemeratoe.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Jearl Margaritha.note: Margaritha's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Jearl Margaritha.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Jeremy Antonisse.note: Antonisse stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Jeremy Antonisse.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Joshua Brenet.note: Brenet's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Joshua Brenet.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Juergen Locadia.note: Locadia is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Juergen Locadia.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Juninho Bacuna.note: Watch Bacuna for creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Juninho Bacuna.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jurien Gaari.note: Watch Gaari for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Jurien Gaari.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Kenji Gorre.note: Gorré's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Kenji Gorre.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Kevin Felida.note: Watch Felida for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Kevin Felida.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Leandro Bacuna.note: Watch Bacuna for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Leandro Bacuna.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Livano Comenencia.note: Comenencia's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Livano Comenencia.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Riechedly Bazoer.note: Bazoer is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Riechedly Bazoer.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Roshon van Eijma.note: Eijma's edge is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Roshon van Eijma.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Sherel Floranus.note: Floranus is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Sherel Floranus.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Shurandy Sambo.note: Sambo's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Shurandy Sambo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Sontje Hansen.note: Hansen's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Sontje Hansen.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Tahith Chong.note: Chong's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Tahith Chong.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Trevor Doornbusch.note: Doornbusch's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Trevor Doornbusch.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Tyrese Noslin.note: Noslin is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Tyrese Noslin.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tyrick Bodak.note: Watch Bodak for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Tyrick Bodak.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。
